answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Coordination leaks: identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases is itself the fingerprint that marks them as one attacker. Picture a echo field, a knoll in flight, a fable in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
